overview.description: The Natixis Loomis Sayles Dynamic Core Plus ETF (LSCP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF providing broad exposure to fixed income securities. The fund employs a top-down macroeconomic analysis in allocating assets across bonds of various credit quality or maturity LSCP was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by Natixis.
